        return ""
    return str(v).replace("\xa0", " ").strip().lower()

    if s in {"", "-", ".", "-."}:

        n = float(s)
        return int(n) if n.is_integer() else n
    except ValueError:
        return None

amount_col = 6        # F
first_data_row = 5

totals = {col: 0 for col in answer_cols}

verify_ws = verify_wb["Sheet1"]

print("Verification for answer range H8:J8:")
for col in answer_cols:
    cell = verify_ws.cell(answer_row, col)
    print(cell.coordinate, repr(cell.value), type(cell.value).__name__)
